changelog.entry: The free sandbox now opens after the third chapter (Loops) instead of the last one, so you can paint rooms and try your own lists much earlier. Nothing you have already cleared changes.

Achievements (fourteen, none timed or luck-based) and a Desktop layout for wide windows: the room fills the stage, your list sits in a side column, and the Rooms, Workshop, Achievements and Settings open as windows from icons or the Menu (Esc). It is the same game and the same save; the Classic layout is unchanged and is still what phones use.

The deck is complete: forty rooms in six chapters, with sub-routines (save a few steps as A or B and call them), conditionals (until and if) and a final chapter, The Long Shift, that mixes everything. Clear the last room and the free sandbox opens: paint any room, write any list, run it as often as you like. Nothing is scored there.

Two more chapters: Turning (left and right, seven rooms) and Loops (repeat blocks, seven rooms). A hint ladder on every room (a nudge, a hint, then the answer; free, and it never touches a medal). Scrap, a salvage drone, gets one part for every room you clear, and a better list gives the same part a better finish. A strip of the next three goals stays in view.

Robot Script opens: write a short list of instructions for a maintenance robot and watch it clear a room. The first chapter, Moving, has seven straight corridors. A run that goes wrong just stops where the robot went wrong and tells you why; your list stays. Gold, silver and bronze medals go to shorter lists. Nothing is timed.
